verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs position it for instant, sub-50ms search-as-you-type experiences, which covers autocomplete-style result retrieval as users type. Nothing in the pack shows query suggestions built from real search traffic or a dedicated suggestions index. Missing for 10: query-suggestion or popular-query generation from search analytics or traffic, a documented suggestions-index workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the autocomplete feature.
